payload.text: **A hook whose script is missing blocks every call it guards.** The interpreter exits 2 when it cannot open its script (python3 does), and 2 is a PreToolUse hook's block code, so the hook fails closed whatever fail-open logic the script itself carries. On rhadamanth's move (23 Oct) a hand-installed hook named its script under `~/.claude/` by path; the script moved and the line did not, and every Bash call in every session was refused until the line was repointed. Before a move, check the user settings for paths under `~/.claude/` (issue 0038).
